scope:
Independent default DeviceCMYK display observations from Python PDF/Poppler.

Sixteen ink corners calibrate the unmanaged device profile. Mixed colors are
held-out checks, not calibration inputs. Vector and image quantization are
observed separately. This is a device policy, not an ISO-mandated conversion.
The native Poppler ABI is used only to measure corner coefficients more precisely
than an eight-bit screenshot permits; no Poppler code is shipped in the engine.
normalization: round independently measured corner fixed RGB/65536 to four decimal places; multilinear interpolation; vector rounds and image truncates RGB*255
